Name: Recycle Your Weapons
Author: Suntooth
Description:
[size=3]This mod lets you put weapons into recycling machines to get back some material that makes sense for that weapon.[/size]

[size=3]A full list of outputs is in the spoiler below:[/size]
[spoiler][size=3]If a weapon isn't listed here, it outputs either 2-6 Iron Ore or 5-10 Wood depending on whether the weapon is made of metal or wood.[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Holy Blade: 2-6 Gold Ore[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Galaxy weapons, Iridium Needle: 2-6 Iridium Ore[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Bone Sword, Ossified Blade: 5-10 Bone Fragments[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Obsidian Edge: 1-2 Obsidian[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Lava Katana: 1-2 Fire Quartz[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Insect Head: 5-10 Bug Meat[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Shadow Dagger: 1-2 Neptunite[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Crystal Dagger: 1-2 Refined Quartz[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Femur: 1 Prehistoric Tibia[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Yeti's Tooth: 1-2 Frozen Tear[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Broken Trident, Dwarf weapons: 2-6 Copper Ore[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Dragontooth weapons: 1 Dragon Tooth[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Infinity weapons: 1-2 Iridium Bar[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Meowmere: 1 Ancient Doll (since that's the item you can use to get Meowmere)[/size][/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[size=3]There is a fallback implemented in this mod where any weapon not explicitly handled will output 2-6 Iron Ore, same as most metal weapons. This should work for modded weapons as long as the mod author has set the item categories correctly. I will not be adding specific outputs for modded weapons unless it's a mod that I use.[/size]
